description: [WRITE] [DESTRUCTIVE] Execute PartiQL statements transactionally (all-or-nothing). Max 100 statements. If any fails, the entire transaction is rolled back. A RETURNING clause is not supported inside a transaction and is rejected with a ValidationException. Example transact_statements: [{"Statement": "INSERT INTO Users VALUE {'pk': 'u1', 'name': 'Alice'}"}]

client_request_token.description: Optional idempotency token for the transaction

return_consumed_capacity.description: What consumed capacity to return: TOTAL for the operation's total, INDEXES for the total broken down by table and index, or NONE (the default) for none. Figures follow DynamoDB's charging rules and match what the DynamoDB API returns for the same request.

transact_statements.description: Array of PartiQL statements (max 100). Each is {Statement: "...", Parameters?: [...], ReturnValuesOnConditionCheckFailure?: "ALL_OLD"|"NONE"}. All succeed or all fail atomically. ALL_OLD returns the item a failed UPDATE or DELETE condition was evaluated against on that statement's cancellation reason.

name: execute_transaction_partiql
